items.title: Ather Energy Q4 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 100 crore; revenue jumps 74% YoY
items.description: Ather Energy Q4 Results: Ather Energy reported a net loss of Rs 100 crore for Q4 FY26, a 57% decrease year-on-year, alongside a 74% revenue jump to Rs 1,175 crore. The company's EBITDA loss narrowed significantly, driven by strong volume growth and improved unit economics, with deliveries reaching 83,418 units.
